The appellant also contended that the respondents-claimants were guilty of suppression of several material facts including execution of sale agreements dated 18.06.1992, etc., between the appellant and respondents-claimants and other documents including compromise petitions, etc. which had culminated in a compromise order dated 28.03.2001 passed in W.P.
